note: Warrick County zoning is shown only in the WTH-hosted county GIS viewer (warrickin.wthgis.com, a Zoning layer checkbox). Probed /arcgis/rest/services and /server/rest/services on that host: both 404; no public REST endpoint for zoning districts was found in the viewer, its pages, or ArcGIS Hub/Online searches.
